title: Headless Techatticup hostages with the mine cleared (#2926, the reporter's case): every actor of CaesarsLegionTechMineFaction in the hostages' cell is killed first; freeing a hostage sends its assault alarm on the faction with no member alive, which must turn nobody (not the hostage), and the second hostage's message box must still open

actions.text: Start as anywhere-i-wander.actions.json: Renolds gives VTechatticup stage 10. The trip and the Legionaries in the mine are not walked: the raiders are alive and in place.
The reporter's order: TechMineNCRHostage2REF (0x0012319C) first. Its script's button 1 ends with SendAssaultAlarm Player 0x001400F9 (the issue's decode).

The mine cleared: every actor in the player's cell that is in CaesarsLegionTechMineFaction is killed (Kill with no killer: no crime). The walkthrough without the kills found 17 members present and alive in the whole load order (its 'assault alarm:' line, the #2926 probe); the scenario requires each hostage's assault_alarm trace event to count 0 members alive anywhere and pick no victim, so a member left alive in another cell fails it.

actions.script:
Begin Function { }
ref rActor
int iKilled
let rActor := GetFirstRef 200 0
while rActor
  if rActor.GetInFaction CaesarsLegionTechMineFaction
    rActor.Kill
    let iKilled += 1
  endif
  let rActor := GetNextRef
loop
SetFunctionValue iKilled
End
actions.label: hostages: raiders killed

actions.text: A headless box is modeless (no given menu): ShowMessage leaves a message_shown event in the trace and menu 1001 opens only for the press frame, so the scenario counts the message_shown events of TecMineHostageMSG (0x001231B8), one per hostage.

The player is moved out of the mine in the frame after the first activation (cell 0x001244CD, as quest 0x0014EA0C reaches stage 100: frame 1801 of the #2926 round-2 trace), so the hostage's GameMode block, which runs the Untie branch and its SendAssaultAlarm, waits until the player is back. Return to the hostage before the reads.

actions.label: hostages: player in combat after the first

actions.text: One raider of the faction, TecLegionaryRaider5REF (0x0011F654, the victim the walkthrough without the kills picks): dead now. The assault_alarm trace events (and, with the log at info for fnv_game::crime, the 'assault alarm:' lines) read victim none and the members dead.

actions.label: hostages: raider 5 in the mine's faction

actions.text: The quest script runs every 5 seconds (default delay): one run sets HostagesFreed, the next stage 20.
